incident: Menschen A2 L01 was falsely reported as Stage2B because PROJECT-STATE.json and central CHECKPOINT.json lagged behind workstream LATEST.json at Stage3C Batch0008.
authority_order: Explicit user-designated newer artifact in current chat; validate identity/integrity
Newest accessible validated portable workstream artifact/checkpoint in current chat, Project Sources or Library, based on actual milestone/lineage not filename or timestamp alone
Workstream-local LATEST.json if present, paired with its cited batch/milestone receipt and artifact identity/hash
Workstream CHECKPOINT.json, only if not contradicted by higher-priority evidence
Global PROJECT-STATE.json summary, only if not contradicted by higher-priority evidence
Historical branches and old reports for recovery/comparison only

startup_gate.derive_directory_from: PROJECT-STATE.json workstream.checkpoint path OR direct workstream path
startup_gate.stale_central_disposition: LABEL_STALE_AND_IGNORE_FOR_PROGRESS; do not downgrade to central status
startup_gate.absence_of_latest: fall back to verified portable, then CHECKPOINT/root summary; record missing pointer, do not invent
startup_gate.conflict_or_hash_mismatch: REPORT_CONFLICT_OR_BLOCKED; do not guess or certify PASS
startup_gate.reporting: Report latest *verified scope* (e.g. Stage3C Batch0008 PARTIAL), open dimensions, explicit blockers, next action, and distinguish Git-recorded tests from tests rerun now
startup_gate.no_forced_sync: Read/check via lightweight metadata; Git is an async durability mirror, not binary transport or production blocker
startup_gate.stage_acceptance: Do not promote bounded batch PASS into full Stage PASS, Stage4 or runtime FINAL

persistence_gate.after_each_validated_workstream_mileston: Persist portable checkpoint and independent QA; update milestone receipt and workstream LATEST.json; attempt bounded Git sync before handoff
persistence_gate.central_checkpoint: Update when safe; if stale keep explicit LATEST pointer authoritative and declare stale
persistence_gate.global_project_state: Refresh when safe; staleness must never hide newer workstream-local progress
persistence_gate.git_failure: Record PENDING/FAILED with exact hash and resume from newest valid portable artifact; no destructive fallback
persistence_gate.parallelism: Re-read the current LATEST SHA before pointer writes; never overwrite a concurrent newer milestone; preserve lesson/source/workstream isolation

known_example.note: Example paths only; do not pin Stage3C Batch0008 as a permanently current result

automation_boundary: Rules are enforced whenever a connected agent begins/resumes work and reads startup policy. This does not launch unattended periodic jobs or force other live chats to refresh automatically.
